name: Rodd & Gunn
verdict: Being rated: a maintainer decides whether an NGO investigation of its supplier factories in Mauritius counts as a finding.
note: Rating note: on hold for a maintainer. Official partner of the Black Foils (SailGP team page, fetched 2026-09-30). The owner is checked: the Companies Register lists Winona R&G, LLC (Chicago) with 57.30%, Michael Beagley and his trust company with 31.45% and Zippin Pty Limited with 10.39%; no state or state fund among them. The open question is the company test: Transparentem's December 2023 investigation of four garment suppliers in Mauritius ('I Came Here with So Many Dreams', transparentem.org/report/mauritius-disclosure) reports high recruitment fees, deceptive recruitment, intimidation and abusive conditions for migrant workers, and lists Rodd & Gunn among the buyers it contacted: with the buyers that collaborated on remediation at Firemount, R.E.A.L and Aquarelle, not with those that reimbursed recruitment fees. The Business & Human Rights Resource Centre recorded that Rodd & Gunn did not respond to its questions (28 Jun 2024). The reported abuse is at supplier factories, not by Rodd & Gunn itself, and no court or regulator finding against the company was found. A Reuters investigation naming it as a customer of Vietnamese manufacturers with Xinjiang-linked cotton suppliers (read only in the NGO Not For Sale's summary) is journalism, not a finding.
